T8645BBBBA2.zh: 直达声起点 · 自定义反射方向
T8645BBBBA2.en: Start with direct sound · Add your own directions

T8D82472AB0.zh: 宽频短尾，平坦低中频、柔和高频滚降；轻量近场起点。
T8D82472AB0.en: A short broadband tail with flat bass and mids and a gentle treble roll-off. A light near-field starting point.

TDD69038D90.zh: （推荐）轻量混响、柔和反射起点与舒展尾部，适合日常听音乐。
TDD69038D90.en: (Recommended) Light reverberation, a gentle onset and an open tail for everyday music listening.

T94F6630F47.zh: 近乎平坦的宽频短反射，少量前向空间；高频轻吸收。
T94F6630F47.en: Short, nearly flat broadband reflections with a little frontal space and light treble absorption.

T3F512209B4.zh: 从低频向高频连续吸收；较长的低频尾部与柔和高频。
T3F512209B4.en: Absorption increases smoothly with frequency, with a longer bass tail and soft treble.

T17594671F9.zh: 较宽的反射频带与紧凑尾部；亮度和尾长分别设定。
T17594671F9.en: Broadband reflections and a compact tail. Brightness and tail length are controlled separately.

T072C17DF84.zh: 反射环绕头部上方，宽频尾部逐渐向高频衰减。
T072C17DF84.en: Reflections surround the upper head, with a broadband tail that gradually decays faster at high frequencies.

T142DF3E3A0.zh: 清晰直接的声像，克制的早段反射与轻量短尾；宽频吸收平滑过渡。
T142DF3E3A0.en: Clear, direct imaging with restrained early reflections and a light short tail; smoothly varying broadband absorption.

T2DA9F071F4.zh: 两只虚拟音箱经人头到达双耳；混响关闭，保留可调音箱角度与空间 EQ。
T2DA9F071F4.en: Two virtual speakers through the head model, with reverberation off and adjustable speaker angles and spatial EQ.

T913C01499F.zh: 混响占主体，低频略长，密集早段之后温和消退。
T913C01499F.en: Reverberation dominates, with a slightly longer bass tail and a gentle decay after a dense early section.

T6B469D0BF5.zh: 远座位的混响比例；宽低频平台、较长低音与逐渐变暗的长尾。
T6B469D0BF5.en: A distant-seat reverberant balance, a broad bass plateau and a long tail that gradually darkens.

T7B2DFFB3C6.zh: 从直达声开始，逐步添加自己的反射源。
T7B2DFFB3C6.en: Start with direct sound and add your own reflection sources.

T48916C7892.zh: 模板方向数量为 2–32 之间的偶数。
T48916C7892.en: Template direction count must be an even number from 2 to 32.

T8E0F99FE89.en: Select at least one existing reflection source.

T00DBD9D3F4.zh: 选一个起点，再调整频谱、衰减和空间分布。

TCF2D5FEFBD.zh: 目标为 EQ 与带通后的混响分量占比。通过整体混响增益预修正保持，结果区显示实际值。

T32F594E193.zh: 支持 WAV、FLAC、MP3、M4A 等格式，导出双声道音频并保留混响尾部。
T32F594E193.en: Accepts WAV, FLAC, MP3, M4A and other formats. Exports stereo audio with the full reverberation tail.

TDA0451AA2A.zh: 音乐分享默认 −18 LUFS，可设 −30 至 −9；LUFS 是整体响度，0 dB 是峰值上限。
TDA0451AA2A.en: Default sharing level: −18 LUFS; range −30 to −9. LUFS measures integrated loudness; 0 dB is the peak ceiling.

T60E35B0043.zh: 响度补偿默认 −18 LUFS；仅限幅保留卷积后电平。
T60E35B0043.en: Loudness normalization defaults to −18 LUFS. Limiter-only mode retains the convolved level.
